diagnostics.message: `aws_sqs_queue_policy.build_queue_dlq_policy` is meant to be the deny-insecure-transport policy for the dead-letter queue, but it sets `queue_url = aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds.id`, so the only edge in the graph is to the main build queue and the DLQ (`aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds_dlq`) is never referenced. That both duplicates `aws_sqs_queue_policy.build_queue_policy`'s ownership of the same queue's policy and leaves the DLQ — the target of `aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds`' `redrive_policy.deadLetterTargetArn` — without any policy. The policy should be attached to and ordered after `aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds_dlq`.
